state: Independent review found two concrete ownership-proof gaps in new process cleanup. A browser root may exit before cleanup so profile-less renderer descendants cannot be discovered, and timestamp-only deduplication may skip distinct PIDs. Capture exact root and descendant identities while root is live, deduplicate by PID/creation, and verify every captured survivor. Managed-service tree admission uses old snapshot ancestry then a fresh PID identity without matching birth/parent identity, risking PID reuse enrollment; require exact snapshot/fresh birth, parent and executable match before admission. Both defects must be fixed before claiming safe cleanup; no unrelated processes may be stopped.

questions.question: Which bounded repair should lead the parallel independent fixes?

options.browser_first: Capture and retain exact browser descendant birth identities before graceful close; remove timestamp-only deduplication and verify all known descendants. Repair service snapshot admission in parallel, then rerun focused lifecycle tests.
options.service_first: Repair service snapshot admission first and retest identity rejection; capture browser descendant identities and eliminate timestamp deduplication in parallel before rerunning browser checks.
